tutorial.title: First run: {{item}}
tutorial.description: Old Doss, a weathered mechanic hanging around {{station}}, stops you. "First time in the sector, huh? Listen: my contact on {{target}} is dying without their {{item}}. Hit the market here, buy a crate, take your ship to {{target}} and hand it over in person. He'll pay well — and he's got an old datapad for you. Trust me, what's on it is worth more than the credits."

craftedDeliveryDesc: {{giver}} needs {{item}} — a part you can't buy anywhere. It has to be crafted at the Workshop before it can be delivered to {{target}}.

delivery: {{giver}} needs {{item}} to reach {{target}} by tomorrow. No detours, no questions.
Sealed package containing {{item}}. Destination: {{target}}. {{giver}} insists on discretion.
{{item}} to be delivered to {{target}}. Looks legal on the surface. What's inside is another story.
Urgent delivery. {{giver}} has a contact on {{target}} waiting for {{item}}. Payment on arrival.
{{giver}} left {{item}} behind on {{target}} during their last visit. You're handling it.
kill: {{boss}} on {{target}}. {{giver}} pays well — and doesn't ask for clean proof.
{{giver}} has a problem with {{boss}}. The solution is expensive. Not solving it costs more.
{{boss}} on {{target}}. Discreet elimination. The client prefers not to be named.
Unofficial bounty on {{boss}}. {{giver}} has their reasons. You need credits. Simple transaction.
{{boss}} has made life impossible for too many people on {{target}}. Someone decided it had to stop.
revenge: People from {{target}} ruined {{giver}}. Go there and win a fight. Make them understand.
{{giver}} has an old debt to settle with {{target}}. They can't go themselves. You can.
An affront went unpunished. A show of force on {{target}} will restore the balance.
{{giver}}'s reputation is on the line. Someone needs to go show who's in charge on {{target}}.
{{giver}} lost something important because of the people on {{target}}. It won't go unanswered.
escort: {{giver}} needs you to escort someone to {{target}}. The person is cooperative. Space, less so.
VIP transport. Destination {{target}}. The passenger boards now. No detours.
A delicate passenger to bring to {{target}}. {{giver}} insists: no questions about who it is.
{{giver}} has someone who absolutely must arrive alive at {{target}}. You make sure it happens.
Secure extraction to {{target}}. The passenger has enemies. Some might be on the way.
sabotage: {{giver}} wants to destabilize {{target}}. A won fight there sends the right message. No need for more.
Pressure operation on {{target}}. Neutralize an opponent on site. The station will remember the rest.
{{giver}} wants {{target}} to know they're not untouchable. Expected result: one enemy defeated on site.
Indirect sabotage. Winning a fight on {{target}} will be enough to disrupt their operations for a few days.
heist: {{item}} is on {{target}}. {{giver}} needs it. How you get it isn't their problem.
Retrieve {{item}} on {{target}}. Buy it, steal it, trade for it — doesn't matter. What counts is the result.
{{giver}} wants {{item}} specifically from {{target}}. The cost will be reimbursed. Plus a bonus.
{{item}} on {{target}}. Figure out how to get your hands on it there. Return with the goods, direct payment.
extraction: {{item}} left on {{target}} in a hurry. {{giver}} pays you to retrieve it and bring it back.
Extraction of {{item}} from {{target}}. Bring it back intact. Someone else needed to leave fast.
{{giver}} has equipment stranded on {{target}}. Retrieve {{item}} and bring it back here. Payment on delivery.
{{item}} on {{target}} belongs to someone other than whoever's holding it. Go get it.
bounty: Bounty on {{boss}} on {{target}}. {{giver}} will verify through their own sources. Dead or incapacitated.
{{boss}} has influential enemies. One of them is paying for a definitive resolution on {{target}}.
Hunting contract. Target: {{boss}}. Location: {{target}}. No deadline. No mercy. Payment on results.
{{giver}} has been tracking {{boss}} for a long time. They can't finish it themselves. You can. {{target}}.
patrol: {{giver}} wants {{target}} to stay under control. Three active passes — explore, show your face, discourage trouble. Payment once secured.
Unstable zone on {{target}}. Needs a physical presence: move around, check access points, hang around hotspots. Three actions on site.
{{giver}} has assets on {{target}} that need to stay intact. Secure the zone over three passes — no report, just presence.
Keeping order on {{target}}. No paperwork, no forms — just show up wherever it's rough, three times. Usually enough.

chain.delivery: Direct follow-up to the contract with {{giver}}. 'There's more to haul than expected — same route, same rate, more cargo.' Reliable.
chain.escort: {{giver}} has a second delicate passenger to escort. 'Same discretion as last time. You know how it works.' Higher pay.
chain.extraction: {{giver}} left something else out there. 'I knew I'd need you a second time. It's ready.' Bonus on top of the last job.
chain.patrol: Still an unstable zone according to {{giver}}. 'Go back there — the situation's shifted. Three passes, like before.' Increased reward.
chain.kill: The target had associates. {{giver}} tracked them down. 'The job was only half done. Want to finish what we started?' High bounty.
chain.revenge: {{giver}} identified others responsible. 'There's more left. Same station, same method. Want the sequel?' Harder. Pays more.
chain.bounty: Cascading contract. The previous target had a backer. {{giver}} traced it. 'The real head is out there.' Higher bounty.
chain.sabotage: {{giver}} wants to push further. 'What we did shook things up. Now's the time to drive it home.' Same target, different mission.
chain.heist: {{giver}} spotted something else on site. 'Going there, you saw what I hadn't. There's more to take there.' Additional acquisition.

descs.kill: Official mission. {{boss}} on {{target}} is a direct threat. The elimination must take place on site — win a fight against the boss there to complete it.
descs.sabotage: Go to {{target}} and win a fight there. It sends the message — the enemy needs to understand your territories have limits.
descs.delivery: The Emporium needs {{item}} to reach {{target}}. Take the goods and deliver them in person — payment on arrival plus faction bonus.
descs.heist: The Emporium wants {{item}} from {{target}}. Go, get it however you see fit, come back with it — guaranteed payment plus faction bonus.
descs.escort: A Cult emissary needs to reach {{target}}. Board the passenger and escort them to the destination.

descs.revenge: {{npcName}} {{flavor}}. People on {{target}} did something they shouldn't have. Go make them understand.
descs.kill: {{npcName}} {{flavor}}. Neutralize a target on {{target}}. No questions about the methods.
descs.patrol: {{npcName}} {{flavor}}. Pass through {{target}} and make sure everything's in order. Report back.
descs.escort: {{npcName}} {{flavor}}. Take a passenger to {{target}}. Safety guaranteed, payment on arrival.
descs.sabotage: {{npcName}} {{flavor}}. Operation on {{target}} — win a fight there. The message will land.
descs.extraction: {{npcName}} {{flavor}}. {{item}} is stranded on {{target}}. Go retrieve it and bring it back.
descs.heist: {{npcName}} {{flavor}}. Acquire {{item}} on {{target}}. The method is up to you.
descs.bounty: {{npcName}} {{flavor}}. Bounty on a target on {{target}}. Dead or incapacitated — doesn't matter.

flavors.Ferrailleur: has parts to pick up or deliver
flavors.Marchande: has a trade route to cover
flavors.Lieutenant: has a mission for the Black Hawks
flavors.Survivante: needs to know what's happening elsewhere
flavors.Organisateur: has interests to keep an eye on
flavors.Gardien: handles things that belong to no one

La Carcasse: A stash of credits from the old regime is supposedly hidden somewhere in the north holds.
A Black Hawk ship was prowling around the station last night. No one knows why.
Fuel prices are climbing again. Someone's controlling the supply — and it's not us.
A mechanic disappeared yesterday. He was working on something he shouldn't have touched.
There's talk of a new trade route bypassing Port Meridian. The merchants are on edge.
Arc Ouest Apocalypse: Alanossa is looking for someone for a job. No details. Extreme pay.
Three ships didn't come back last week. Alanossa's territory.
Word is Alanossa has a bounty on someone new. Maybe you.
The Black Hawks are recruiting. Vague criteria. Surviving the interview isn't guaranteed.
A defector from the Emporium took refuge here. He has information. And enemies.
Port Méridien: Prices are going up next week. Reliable source. Buy now.
A mysterious delivery arrived last night with no recipient. It's still waiting.
Security's been tightened. Someone important is expected — or someone dangerous.
A pilot proposed a direct route to the deep zones. No one took him up on it.
The Emporium is opening an office here. Independent traders are getting nervous.
Les Bas-Fonds de Vega: Boro received a sealed package yesterday. He hasn't slept since.
A faction is looking for a discreet transporter. Very discreet. Untraceable cash payment.
Customs has been bribed. For how long, no one knows.
Someone's selling stolen military plans. The seller changes address every hour.
A bounty hunter arrived this morning. Looking for someone. Maybe you.
Fort Kharos: The army is preparing an operation in the deep zones. Recruitment underway.
An officer disappeared with his unit's equipment. Internal investigation.
Experimental munitions were tested last week. Results classified.
A military convoy was attacked on the route to The Wreckyard. No survivors.
The Guardians are looking for an informant in their ranks. The mood is tense.
La Citadelle Écarlate: Myrra summoned all her lieutenants this morning. Closed-door meeting.
An Emporium delegation arrived yesterday. No one knows what they discussed.
An underground tournament is being held in the lower levels. Entry stake: 500cr.
The Guardians lost a forward post in the ruins. They haven't reported on casualties.
Someone graffitied 'THE VOID IS COMING' in seven different corridors. The mood is strange.
Le Purgatoire: Neva says she saw something in the level 7 corridors. She refuses to elaborate.
A former prisoner came back. Looking for something he left here.
The Cult of the Void holds meetings in the sub-levels. Participants unknown.
An old gambling debt resurfaces. It'll end in blood, as usual.
An abandoned extraction shaft has been reopened. No one knows by whom or why.
Nexus Aldara: Lira cracked a system that wasn't supposed to be crackable. She's been unreachable since.
A military AI prototype was stolen. The army is searching — quietly.
Anomalies in the local network for three days. Origin unidentified.
An engineer is offering to sell plans for a banned propulsion system. Plenty of buyers.
A research team never returned from their last expedition. Their equipment did.
default: Trade routes are changing. Some turn dangerous overnight.
A faction war is brewing somewhere in the sector. It's going to spill over.
There's talk of a forgotten treasure in a zone no one visits anymore. For good reason.
The black market is active. Someone's selling something that shouldn't exist.
A pilot vanished on last week's route. His ship was found empty.
Fuel prices are fluctuating strangely. Someone's manipulating the markets.
There's a rumor about a Nexus fragment hidden in an abandoned station.
Survivors of a battle describe an unknown weapon. No one quite believes them.
